question: Does using the pre-second-edit parent A (GolfBall_ep0.pt) as the close_form_emb_regzero adversarial-embedding reference, instead of original M0, prevent sequential refinement corruption while preserving deletion and retained capabilities?
status_at_freeze_time: FROZEN BEFORE EXECUTION -- 2026-10-14, prior to any new GPU computation under this directory
frame: Causal diagnostic of sequential adaptation, not a new-method claim. Development evidence; generality/novelty unestablished.

working_model_checkpoint.name: AB_UCE.pt
working_model_checkpoint.role: Pre-second-edit Stage-1 (preliminary UCE) result, starting from A. Loaded untouched; refined exactly once in this experiment.

reference_checkpoint_A.name: GolfBall_ep0.pt
reference_checkpoint_A.role: Parent A, loaded into a SEPARATE pipeline object and supplied as the close_form_emb_regzero reference (model_copy), replacing pristine M0. Never edited.

existing_comparator_checkpoint.name: AtoB_english_springer.pt
existing_comparator_checkpoint.role: Existing final A->B (M0-reference) checkpoint. Used ONLY for the image-free replay comparison; not re-edited.

single_change: Only the `model_copy` argument supplied to close_form_emb_regzero changes, from a pristine M0 pipeline to a pipeline loaded with checkpoint A (GolfBall_ep0.pt). The working model (model=) is loaded from AB_UCE.pt in both the replay check and the AB_REF_A build, never restarted from A and never re-run through preliminary UCE. AB-UCE itself is never used as a reference.

unchanged_refinement_procedure.precision: float32, unchanged from original working-model behavior

stages: 1. Verify AB_UCE.pt and GolfBall_ep0.pt sha256 against this manifest.

2. Image-free replay: load AB_UCE.pt as working model, fresh pristine M0 pipeline as reference; run close_form_emb_regzero + edit_model_adversarial with the unchanged hyperparameters above; compare ALL resulting UNet tensor VALUES (torch.equal per key, not file hash) against AtoB_english_springer.pt. If any key differs: record differing keys + max abs/rel diff, publish discrepancy, STOP before building AB_REF_A or generating any image. No tolerance, no new comparator, no repair loop.

3. Only if the replay reproduces the comparator exactly: reload a FRESH, untouched AB_UCE.pt working model (do not reuse or re-refine the replayed object) and a fresh pipeline loaded with A as reference. Verify storage separation across ALL UNet tensors (not one probe key). Run the same close_form_emb_regzero + edit_model_adversarial call with model_copy=A instead of M0. Verify reference A's full UNet state dict is unchanged after refinement (all tensors, value comparison). Assert exactly the 32 expected cross-attention to_k/to_v keys changed vs. the AB_UCE input; report the actual changed-key count and list.

4. Save diagnostic traces: both recovered concept/adversarial embeddings (replay-M0 vs A-reference), their norms and difference, and per-branch refinement update norms. Compute G = 0.1*I + sum(W_l^T W_l) from the fixed working (AB_UCE) weights independently for both branches and verify bit-identical.
5. Save the result as AB_REF_A.pt with an edit log mirroring run_edit.py's fields.

6. Generate at most 100 new images for AB_REF_A only, on the identical frozen 100-case manifest, reusing generate_confirmation.py/classify_confirmation.py unmodified. Reuse all existing outputs for every other endpoint (M0, A, B, B-UCE, AB-UCE, A->B).

7. Blind-as-feasible visual review (fixed case order, checkpoint identity hidden only to the extent the existing tooling allows -- same stated limitation as prior reviews in this line), separating object presence/absence/ambiguity, generic-dog presence, and severe degeneration. Full-resolution inspection of uncertain cases.
8. Report recognition, paired quality transitions, and tradeoffs; keep the conclusion conditional per the task's framing.
9. Publish report + compact evidence to bijay299/XXResearch; release the GPU.
max_scope: One image-free replay of the existing M0-reference refinement from the AB-UCE input.
No other experiments, reference variants, tuning, or automatic follow-up.
do_not: Do not use AB-UCE itself as the reference.
Do not restart the working model from A or rerun preliminary UCE.
Do not change guide/retain texts, technique, K/V-only scope, or any hyperparameter besides the reference identity.
Do not introduce a tolerance, substitute comparator, or enter a repair loop if the replay check fails.
Do not run a regularization or layer sweep.
Do not launch alternative references or tune until something improves.
